needs.premise: One cohort and two registered writers; delayed application, enrollment cut, VM custody, PSTATE pins and join outcomes; ordinary/helper-entry profiles; complete manifest, closure endpoint, physical independence and atomic gate transitions are premises; not C source, weak-memory or arbitrary-death progress proof

22 conditional declarations: closure requirements, registered-child debt, Custody Step/Trace preservation, no-join envelope retention, and independent data-freeze condition; not full QNT or C simulation

Scheme emits a writer-effect descriptor per SFUN/CFUN variant and raw code site, with module/code identity, operation and transitive callees; managed marker cohort rejects unmanifested arbitrary C/FFI aliases, old generated kernel and escaped callback/native write capabilities; bounded symbol search is evidence of named routes, not an exhaustive whole-program effect analysis; no source-level DataWriteClosed issuer currently exists

Original writer endpoint is after argument/result conversion, all conversion-error retry calls and generated release/conversion helpers, marker physical clear, exactly-once refcount handoff, result/root custody and final managed effect, but before a no-managed-reentry postlude; nonmatching ___call rethrow and ___run TRY escape require off-stack exceptional guard; AT_END is selected source text, not a universal finally; propagate_error/THROW and TRY catcher restoration remain effect or PSTATE-pin obligations, not assumed harmless epilogues; each nested activation closes only its own identity; borrowed stack/TLS/PSTATE pins remain separate

Every native helper, queued task and callback descendant registers its debt before parent can discharge its effect responsibility; one atomic admission cut orders helper registration against enrollment close; registered but not enqueued/dequeued helpers remain owed until completed or cancellation proves no effect; certify only after all members close and issued effects drain; helper work after certificate requires a newly counted cohort before domain freeze, never reopening an old seal

VM service prepares canonical operation/root/domain/code/ticket backing before accepting custody with one authoritative decision and stable identity; acceptance survives lost response and query does not replay; backing audit rejects pointers to PSTATE list sentinels, stack roots, current closure TLS or locks still destroyed by source cleanup; transfer ownership without copying whole heap; source duty persists until exact acceptance observed; join failure or unknown never refunds debt or drops VM roots

Before cleanup_pstate, transfer controlled nodes and RC payload roots to VM-owned canonical domain and scan view, unlink transferred nodes from destructive source walks under excluded scan/sweep access, close original writes and drain source PSTATE pins; native postlude/thread/TLS envelope remains until its own stop and reader proof; cleanup_interrupts and free_still release_foreign can spawn effects, so classify and transfer finalizer/interrupt work before seal or open a separately registered cleanup cohort; procedural interrupt cleanup calls external execute_fn(intr,false) while holding its queue mutex, so reentrant enqueue cannot be drained under that lock; no synchronous owner/GC wait cycle

Record exact native join return and target incarnation, with at most one join authority; successful native termination can support original stop but cannot certify helper closure, operation outcome, physical backing survival or whole-VM drain; failed/unknown join preserves native envelope and canonical VM custody; separately proven cooperative data closure may allow GC without native join; no blind second join on a reused identifier or destruction of TLS/code/locks still borrowed

One synchronization domain orders registration, membership-close and seal; producer release closure follows every last effect and coordinator acquire sees all participants; VM acceptance release follows initialized independent backing/root scan registration and cleanup acquires canonical acceptance; source unlink and target scan view commit share exclusion; no plain/atomic access mix, compiler motion or arbitrary native cancellation silently assumed safe

Immutable LinkIntent publishes exact operation/VM/domain/generation, fresh node not already in the well-formed old chain, old head, body proof, root and allocation tickets before first link effect; journal ACKs follow data and may lag it; helpers never trust partly prepared record or ACK absence alone; intent, root cells, domain and native code backing outlive all original/helper borrowers

Controlled cohort uses real atomic native head with all readers adapted; under stable exclusive domain authority after prior writer stop, head==old permits reconstruction of node.next from immutable intent then release publication, head==node with next==old confirms success without reinsertion, every other head/shape refuses; next remains immutable after head visibility until exclusive sweep; no mixing atomic head with old raw PSTATE stores

StopCertificate names exact operation, writer/thread incarnation, domain lease and every helper lineage; normal cooperative endpoint closes future stores, or exact successful native termination/join plus drained final effects supports native stop; logical Scheme exit, generation increment, timeout, pthread id reuse or failed/ignored join do not; known stop alone does not recover locks, freed storage or invalid structure

Commit publishes one pre-backed immutable DecisionEnvelope pointer by atomic compare-exchange after body/list/root installation; envelope holds stable root handles and allocation ticket, not untracked movable SCMOBJ; ticket role reserved/live and result come from same decision; no scalar increment/decrement replay; null before stop is pending observation, nonnull qualifies committed result but not writer drain

Unknown head/commit result retains operation, root and domain lease; after known stop helpers reconcile actual atomic head/decision, finish exact existing operation and never allocate/free or jump native frame from query; committed outcome with pending writers still refuses GC freeze; GC coordinator does not block holding a lock needed by target/helper, no join/GC barrier wait cycle

Actual C acquire/release and atomic object layout refine immutable-intent visibility, next-before-head publication, observed head classification and one decision CAS; all accesses use compatible types and lifetime protection; compiler/target lock-free support is not assumed, owner-death inside nonrecoverable atomic/lock backend remains unsupported; stop certificates establish no future effects before freeze/reuse

nodes.labelText: Register original + helper debt\nbefore native publication
Close enrollment atomically\nqueued debt remains counted
Last managed write / cleanup\nexception guard per activation
DataWriteClosed\nall E writers + issued effects drained
Prepare independent VM roots\nnode / domain / code / ticket
Canonical VM custody accepted\nlost ACK -> query, no replay
Detach source physical chains\nzero source PSTATE pins
Admitted PSTATE data cleanup\nhelper may continue on VM backing
Domain GC freeze\nall cohorts closed; native envelope separate
Retain roots / domain / native envelope\nunknown effect refuses dependent GC
SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean\nsource and C refinement open

diagramEdges.labelText: failed or unknown retains native backing

callers.actualChain: c-define and function converters emit void, SCMOBJ and typed SFUN variants; argument/result conversions and generated release wrappers surround calls; errors may retry
callers.hazard: End of successful Scheme call is before result conversion, error retry, marker clear and propagation
callers.replacement: Generate effect/exit descriptors and explicit off-stack close guard for every variant; close after last managed effect, not after SFUN_CALL

callers.actualChain: c-lambda emits inline/out-of-line context, optional cleanup TRY, user text or function, AT_END and result publication
callers.hazard: Arbitrary C text can return/longjmp/spawn or retain aliases; AT_END does not wrap every escape
callers.replacement: Managed raw C effect declaration plus admitted endpoint protocol, otherwise reject controlled cohort; preserve user Scheme semantics separately

callers.actualChain: make_vector allocates/fills before marker procedure/processor body writes; proc root TODO
callers.hazard: Publishing seal at allocation return omits later body writes; local proc may lack root across allocation
callers.replacement: Root proc before allocating; typed safe marker shell/initialization transaction and issuer after body/result publication

callers.actualChain: kill clears vector0 then decrements raw still refcount
callers.hazard: Seal before kill misses both writes; repeated cleanup may decrement twice
callers.replacement: Move physical marker retirement into canonical guarded effect; exactly-once decision not a second scalar authority

callers.actualChain: Conversion handler and return-to-C inspect marker procedure/processor; generated C retains raw access
callers.hazard: Scheme-only generator change leaves old generated readers and raw vector alias interpretation
callers.replacement: Regenerate admitted modules; typed marker operations and fixed subtype/profile manifest; legacy module gated out of controlled cohort

callers.actualChain: ___call matching return restores frame; nonmatching throws; ___run TRY can escape before normal kill
callers.hazard: Normal END and C local guard do not cover every nonlocal exit or nested activation
callers.replacement: Off-stack guard owns original identity/root/initialization duty; nested guard closes itself; preserve Scheme continuation return rights

callers.actualChain: Allocator links next/head before count/length/header and caller-filled body; release decrements
callers.hazard: Generic allocation end cannot certify caller initialization or helper/link stores
callers.replacement: VM controlled domain preserves intent, shape and writer lineage; per-operation construction close distinct from whole domain scan close

callers.actualChain: RC sentinel per PSTATE, register links four fields, set_data writes payload, release unlinks/frees; closure producer fills root
callers.hazard: Copying sentinel pointer to VM leaves PSTATE dependency; P0-only mark_rc branch does not scan transferred nonzero roots
callers.replacement: Canonical VM root domain with physical relink and all-domain scan admission; RC and still accounting remain distinct

callers.actualChain: Setup marks; sweep rewrites links/counters, free_still clears head and invokes foreign release functions
callers.hazard: Cleanup itself writes and may call foreign producer after an earlier data seal
callers.replacement: Phase-authorized cleanup cohort and finalizer effect profile; transfer task/root/native resource before original domain seal

callers.actualChain: Procedural interrupt enqueue takes target mutex; cleanup invokes execute_fn(intr,false) under that mutex, then clears head/tail before mem cleanup
callers.hazard: An unclosed enqueue producer can race cleanup; cleanup interrupt release is outside SFUN generator coverage
callers.replacement: Close external interrupt admission; transfer callback debt under queue lock then invoke admitted callback outside locks or reject reentrant handler; pin target incarnation

callers.actualChain: Shrink child cleanup then thread_exit; P0 join ignores return; grow setup failure cleans attempted states
callers.hazard: Join happens after destructive cleanup; rollback is a separate cleanup caller, not evidence of initialized cohort
callers.replacement: VM acceptance + detach/closure preflight common to shrink and partially initialized rollback; source bug speculation is outside this study

callers.actualChain: cleanup disables global interrupts, shrinks and calls cleanup_pstate; cleanup exported through GSTATE
callers.hazard: Patching resize alone leaves direct shutdown/exported cleanup capable of destroying backing
callers.replacement: Single cleanup admission service for every call route; distinguish no-publication rollback from live-cohort handoff

callers.actualChain: Starter invokes start_fn; join converts nonzero pthread return via errno; thread_set_pstate sets TLS/affinity
callers.hazard: Failed/unknown join is no stop proof; data closure alone does not authorize reclaim of TLS/native envelope
callers.replacement: Preserve raw return/incarnation/single join owner; retain envelope until known termination and native readers drain

callers.actualChain: PSTATE OS cleanup closes select-abort handle; VM cleanup destroys memory/scan locks then P0 memory cleanup
callers.hazard: VM-owned pointer can still depend on OS handle, scan lock or root storage being destroyed
callers.replacement: Audit physical dependency graph and GC view before receipt; VM shutdown must drain service before its shared infrastructure

callers.actualChain: Function-valued callbacks use RC payload and current closure self; native libraries own callback/delete timing
callers.hazard: Helper/callback capability can outlive parent; global closure self/TLS TODO and raw aliases defeat local closure proof
callers.replacement: Register before native publication; foreign unregister/drain receipt, explicit closure identity/root/code lease; reject unbounded raw origins

callers.actualChain: GSTATE exposes marker/thread functions; emulated CAS takes hashed mutex; selected recovery helper is proposed, absent current source
callers.hazard: Unregistered helper or abandoned backend lock invalidates closure; symbol search cannot prove all loaded C aliases
callers.replacement: Typed helper admission before enqueue/effect; complete module/effect manifest; unknown holder keeps duty and blocks dependent GC domain
